aide.q: How do I add a show to my schedule?
aide.a: Tap the pin icon on a performance. The Schedule sorts your choices by day and flags slots that overlap.

aide.q: How do I set a show aside?
aide.a: Tap the little heart on the map or on the show's page: it appears in Favorites.

aide.q: How do I find a venue on the map?
aide.a: Use “See on the map” under a performance, the search at the top of the map, or the list of venues in the Menu. Tap a marker to see the shows playing there.

aide.q: What do IN and OFF mean?
aide.a: Artistic projects are either selected by the festival (In Selection) or programmed (Off Selection). The IN/OFF filter in the Discover list lets you choose one or the other.

aide.q: Are my favorites and my schedule saved?
aide.a: Yes, but only on this device and in this browser. Clearing the browser data erases them.

cgu: This application is a demonstration prototype made as part of a portfolio project.
The shows, times, venues and texts come from the official website of the Chalon dans la rue festival. They belong to the festival and to the companies concerned.
No personal data is sent: your favorites, your schedule and your settings stay saved on your device.
